quotes.quote: First compare the proposed action with the user's task. A status question permits a status read.

A rollback changes the world. It needs a separate approval tied to the target and current conditions. A valid tool name and well-formed arguments describe the request; they do not supply that approval.

answers.reason: The status task authorizes a read. A valid rollback proposal supplies no separate approval, so the runtime must reject the write and retain the existing scope.

quotes.quote: Attempt one and attempt two need different tracing identifiers. Both can point to the same operation key.
If the controller enforces its idempotency contract, the same key and payload can return the original job. Reusing that key with a different target must produce a conflict.

answers.reason: Preserve the operation key and exact payload while assigning the new transport attempt its own identifier.

quotes.quote: On resume, reconcile the operation key with the controller and check the job's current state. If the trusted observation says queued, report that it was queued when checked. Keep the observation time with the claim.
Completion still requires a later observation from the system executing it.

answers.reason: Apply the observation-based reporting method to processing: the job was processing when checked. Neither the checkpoint nor that observation establishes completion.

quotes.quote: Under this policy, treat a valid Retry-After hint as a minimum wait. Parse either delay seconds or an HTTP date. Add a bounded random offset after that floor if the policy needs to spread a synchronized group, then check the combined delay against the caller's deadline.
The deadline is the outside limit for the whole task. When a compliant wait no longer fits, stop and report the unresolved state.

answers.reason: The combined wait is 1.1 + 0.4 = 1.5 seconds. It exceeds the 1.3 seconds remaining, so stop.

quotes.quote: In this fixture, a new relevant page identifier resets the no-progress allowance. A repeated page does not. The hard call budget keeps shrinking in either case, so apparent progress cannot create unlimited work.

answers.reason: The consecutive stall counts are 0, 1, 0, 1, 2, 0. C resets stalls on the sixth call, but the six-call cap blocks a seventh.

quotes.quote: Suppose an older request succeeds after a newer failure has opened the circuit. Return that result to its caller, while keeping the newer breaker state. A generation check prevents stale health evidence from replacing current state.

answers.reason: Return A's successful result, but its generation-4 evidence cannot replace the newer open generation-5 state.

quotes.quote: A canceled half-open probe releases its local slot, reopens for cooldown in this policy and propagates cancellation.
None of these local transitions proves that a remote write was canceled.

answers.reason: Release the slot, reopen for cooldown and propagate cancellation. The local cancellation does not resolve remote effects.

quotes.quote: Evidence must come through a trusted adapter, identify the right run and operation, and satisfy the claim’s freshness policy.

Now suppose a backup only has a completed observation from forty minutes ago and the current-status policy allows one minute. The old state does not establish completion now. Preserve the unresolved operation and report current status unavailable, with a dated prior observation if useful.

answers.reason: Twenty-five minutes exceeds the 90-second freshness limit. Report current status unavailable and identify the earlier observation by its date or time.

quotes.quote: A context window bounds one request, while cumulative tokens bound the run. With a hundred-token fixed prefix and fifty added history tokens per turn, four prompts contain one hundred, one hundred fifty, two hundred and two hundred fifty tokens: seven hundred submitted input tokens. In general it is n times h plus s times n times the quantity n minus one, divided by two.

Reserve conservative input plus bounded output before dispatch, then reconcile actual usage. A request needing at most one hundred twenty input and eighty output tokens cannot enter a run with only one hundred fifty left under this policy.

answers.reason: The three inputs contain 80, 120 and 160 tokens, totaling 360. The next reservation requires 200 + 80 = 280 tokens, exceeding the 250 remaining, so reject it.

quotes.quote: A compensation is a new action on current state.
Inspect the real effects and current permissions before selecting forward repair, compensation or human review.
Safe recovery keeps permission, proposal, transport attempt, durable effect, and verification distinct.

answers.reason: The confirmed refund verifies the payment effect only. Read the independent reservation's current status, then admit any needed cancellation under current authority.
